items.name: audit_portability
items.description: Alias for detect_hardcode. Scans workspace or specific directory across multiple programming languages for non-portable hardcoded absolute paths.

items.name: detect_hardcode
items.description: Scans workspace or specific file/directory across ALL file types (GUI/HTML/Svelte/Vue/JSX/TSX/CSS, JS/TS, Python, PHP, Go, Rust, C/C++, Shell, Batch, PowerShell, JSON, YAML, TOML, INI, ENV, SQL, Dockerfile) for non-portable hardcoded absolute host paths (e.g. /home/..., /Users/..., C:\..., D:\..., /root/..., /tmp/..., /etc/..., /var/..., /opt/...), non-portable path separators, and host-locked configurations. Provides exact file and line locations, matched code snippets, and language-specific cross-platform refactoring recommendations.
